title: Pool Service Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Pool Service: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Pool Service Completion Report covers pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature. The residential pool-service coordinator records Residential Pool Service performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Pool Service Completion Report keeps Residential Pool Service exceptions visible until the residential pool-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pool Service Completion Report at residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate. Document pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature identity before Residential Pool Service begins. Compare pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature findings with stated Residential Pool Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Pool Service issues to qualified pool-service reviewer. For Pool Service Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Pool Service. Ask qualified pool-service reviewer to review Residential Pool Service conditions beyond the residential pool-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completed-scope context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Pool Service, identify responsible parties, residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate, and the linked pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature source.

fields.label: Service interval, target range, and prior reading

sections.title: Delivered result and verification evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Pool Service facts for pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Pool Service completion checks
items: Filter pressure, flow, pump, and leak condition
Skimmer, basket, surface, wall, floor, and debris condition
Chemical supply, feeder, storage, and label condition
Gate, barrier, drain cover, and visible deck condition
Adjustment, circulation, retest, and customer restriction

sections.title: Remaining work, evidence, and next owner
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Pool Service conditions; have residential pool-service coordinator assign the next Residential Pool Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Equipment cannot circulate or maintain control
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Pool Service when water, chemical, circulation, barrier, visibility, or safe-use control remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Pool Service proof and route unresolved pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature scope to residential pool-service coordinator.
